text: In a travelling French circus, the beautiful trapeze artist Cleopatra seduces Hans, a sideshow dwarf, after learning of [his large inheritance|wants|wealth and ambition], and plots with the strongman Hercules to kill him. At their wedding feast she [slips poison into his wine|images|food, drink and drugs] and drives off the performers in disgust. Hans, played for a fool, [secretly plots with the other entertainers|rules|people turn on each other], and on a night of [storm and overturned wagons|images|weather, sky and darkness] Cleopatra flees into the forest with them close behind.
